# sherpa-nav-section

A section label + rule that groups items in a nav rail.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | nav |
| Figma | Navigation Section/default |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-nav-section/sherpa-nav-section.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-nav-section/sherpa-nav-section.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-nav-section/sherpa-nav-section.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-nav-section/sherpa-nav-section.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-nav-section/sherpa-nav-section.example.json) |

## When to use it

For a Section in a nav you build by hand: a label and a rule that do nothing. It has no slot, so put the `sherpa-nav-item` rows after it, not inside it; `sherpa-nav` draws its own sections from `populate()`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-nav-section data-label="Workspace"><sherpa-nav-item data-icon="home" data-label="Home" data-href="?context=home"></sherpa-nav-item></sherpa-nav-section>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-collapsed` | boolean |  | present on a collapsed rail — hides the label, keeps the rule |
| `data-label` | text |  | the section label text (rendered verbatim — author its case) |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`label`, `rule`

## CSS custom properties it reads

What each class's base rule reads:

| Custom property | Class | Property |
|---|---|---|
| `--sherpa-theme-content-body-1` | `.label` | `color` |
| `--sherpa-font-size-body-xs` | `.label` | `font-size` |
| `--sherpa-font-weight-regular` | `.label` | `font-weight` |
| `--sherpa-theme-content-line-height-xs` | `.label` | `line-height` |
| `--sherpa-border-top` | `.rule` | `border-block-start` |

## populate()

`{ collapsed?, label? }`

Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.
